newsitem.title: UK: BES issues 20 bln esc perpetual bonds.
newsitem.headline: BES issues 20 bln esc perpetual bonds.

text.p: Banco Espirito Santo said it was issuing 20 billion escudos of perpetual subordinated bonds paying interest of three-month Lisbor plus 68 basis points for the first seven years, or 28 coupons.
From the 29th coupon onwards, the bonds will pay three-month Lisbor plus 218 basis points, it said.
The issue will be launched at par and has a call option, also at par, that can be exercised from the 28th coupon onwards at each subsequent interest payment date.
The issue is organised and coordinated by BES, with Banco ESSI, Banco Portugues de Investimento and Caixa Geral de Depositos (CGD) acting as lead managers.
